operation: Original supplied Y6 bicycle B. All nine original lowest-detail l2 parts combined with original triangles, normals and UVs. No topology synthesis or LOD mixing. Original hierarchy transforms baked and original rhpos rebased to the held origin. Grip rail uses mesh vertices nearest original rhpos/lhpos plus the farthest continuation. Whole object is rigid while carried; individual wheel/pedal physics fragments are not recreated.
